gradient_decomposition.mathematical_basis: InfoNCE gradient exactly equals (p_positive - 1)*gradient(positive logit) + sum_j p_negative_j*gradient(negative logit); probabilities are stop-gradient for attributed directional gradients; positive/negative surrogate scalar values are not losses
checks: sum weighted positive and negative gradients equals weighted original InfoNCE encoder gradient to numerical tolerance
original RT4 optimizer and data flow reproduced exactly at all epochs and full saved training history matches
all gradient attributes on train rows only and operator-gradient isolation for identity term
report gradient norms, pairwise cosines, relative dot products, and change-in-pair-distance first-order directional projections

interpretation.H1_support: material negative cosine and non-negligible gradient magnitudes between positive attraction, reconstruction or residual suppression, persisting at later checkpoints (descriptive only)
interpretation.H1_not_supported: objectives aligned or conflicts negligible at sampled cells; cannot infer a general absence of interference
limitations: two sampled fold/scanner cells are diagnostic not representative or independent
gradient sign does not establish actual training counterfactual or biological label retention
pre-optimizer evaluation after exact frozen fitting reproduction
no results or new model promotion
